title: Dave Canales confirms Nic Scourton suffered knee injury, will undergo MRI

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Dave Canales confirms Nic Scourton suffered knee injury, will undergo MRI
sources.description: Panthers outside linebacker Nic Scourton did suffer a right knee injury during the club’s first training camp practice on Thursday, head coach Dave Canales confirmed in his press conference after the session.
